canonized_runs.repair_summary: Applied deterministic transport-only escaping to the two unescaped internal "AI Diffusion" quotations in the raw JSON payload.

issuer_finding_summary: Across the canonized NVDA P4 runs, novelty is concentrated in a small number of named AI-regulation and export-control specifics, while the broader FY2025 move is better read as intensified supply-execution and export-control detail layered onto a largely reused Item 1A structure.
p4_role_statement: This Fresh vs reused lens separates genuinely new disclosure from intensified or reused filing structure. It is narrower than the main summary and stays secondary because the primary read still delivers the better first read.
known_quality_caveats: The NVDA standard P4 raw response required deterministic transport repair for unescaped internal quotation marks around AI Diffusion.
The repaired NVDA standard object still carries one manifest-linked evidence row for the main caveat instead of a filing paragraph; that quality debt is logged, not silently rewritten.
standard_and_extended_agreement_note: Yes. Both runs treat AI Diffusion as the clearest fresh point, keep Blackwell and supply execution in the intensified bucket, and read most of the filing as reused framework language rather than a wholly new risk map.
integration_note: Suitable for a compact secondary module because the core fresh-versus-reused pattern holds across both runs even after the standard-run transport repair.

comparison_to_02.where_p4_adds_value: Fresh vs reused adds a cleaner secondary check than the primary read, especially around AI Diffusion, the EU AI Act, and Blackwell as a new example inside an older risk family.
comparison_to_02.where_02_remains_stronger: The primary read remains stronger as the broad default synthesis because it leads with the main filing shift and stays more robust and investor-readable.
comparison_to_02.why_secondary_only: Fresh vs reused is too narrow and slightly more quality-sensitive to replace the primary read, but it is useful as a bounded second lens on novelty claims.

fresh_2025_specifics.text: FY2025 adds the January 2025 AI Diffusion rule as a newly named worldwide export-control regime rather than just another example inside the older export-control theme.
